name: treety-workspace
description: A hierarchical terminal workspace for VS Code and future hosts.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @treety/core run build && pnpm --filter @treety/cli run build && pnpm --filter @treety/pi run build && pnpm --filter treety run build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @treety/core run check && pnpm --filter @treety/core run build && pnpm --filter @treety/cli run check && pnpm --filter @treety/pi run check && pnpm --filter treety run check
scripts.release:publish: pnpm release:verify && pnpm changeset publish && pnpm release:publish:vscode
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @treety/core run test && pnpm --filter @treety/cli run test && pnpm --filter @treety/pi run test
